notes.title: 🎮 UPDATE 1: NEW WAYS TO PLAY - OUT NOW! 🎮
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/3781fd376de5d63e9c67af4cff8c748944a5f51e.png"][/img][/p][p]🌱 [b]Dear Sproutlings[/b] 🌱  [/p][p]It's been a hot minute since we announced this update - but now its finally ready to go.[/p][p]Heres what we added to Space Sprouts today:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎮 Controller Support![/b] [/h3][p]You can now enjoy Space Sprouts with your favourite controller. This was a bit harder than you might think ([i]Unity UI cough[/i]). We did quite a lot of testing to make throwing things around as satisfying as possible. And we're really happy that now you can just sit back and mess around with all the weird things in our game with a controller - it just [i]feels nice[/i]. And of course you can always re-map everything in the settings menu![/p][p][/p][h3][b]💨Steam Deck Optimization![/b] [/h3][p]You can now play Space Sprouts on the go with your Steam Deck. It took us quite a bit of time (and help from our most favourite tech wizard) to optimize it for the Deck. We're really happy with its performance now and seeing our game running on that pretty OLED screen really made us smile. If you've got a Steam Deck give it a spin. [/p][p]There are of course limits to what the little machine can handle in terms of item duplication and black hole shenanigans - so experiment at your own risk. If you run into any problems let us know on our Discord. And if it runs fine, let Steam know - so we might get that prestigious "Verified" badge some time in the future.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]🇨🇳 Simplified Chinese Localization![/b] [/h3][p]With the help of two lovely people from the Space Sprouts community the game now has an official Simplified Chinese translation. As a tiny team we are so grateful to see people actively helping us to make Space Sprouts accessible to more players around the world. Thanks so much TE-Eh & Butterfly, you're rad![/p][p][/p][h3][b]🧠 3 New Memories![/b] [/h3][p]We also added three new memories to discover on your big ol' space ship. Might they be connected to this update? Take another flight, poke around and find it out yourself! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/eacc247110f3e468d6dc3617daa1aac731cd0293.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Thats it for the first update.[/b] The second update SECRETS & MEMORIES is in the works and is coming as soon as possible.[/p][p][/p][p]Cheers & thanks for playing![/p][p]- [i]The Schleuder Gäng[/i]  [/p][p][/p][p]⭐💚 And don’t forget[b] [/b]to [b]leave a review for[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2790020/Space_Sprouts/"] Space Sprouts[/url][/b], it helps us more than you might think 💚⭐  [/p][p][/p][h3]Find us online:[/h3][p]🌱[url="https://bsky.app/profile/schleudergames.bsky.social"]Space Sprouts on BlueSky[/url] [/p][p]🌱[url="https://www.instagram.com/schleudergames/"]Space Sprouts on Instagram[/url] [/p][p]🌱[url="https://www.tiktok.com/@schleudergames"]Space Sprouts on Tiktok[/url] [/p][p]🌱[url="discord.gg/kWupKv9WGd"]Join us on Discord[/url] [/p][p]🌱[url="https://schleuder.games/"]Our official website[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Love, Peace & Video Games[/b] 🌈  [/p]

tags.feature: You can now enjoy Space Sprouts with your favourite controller. This was a bit harder than you might think (Unity UI cough). We did quite a lot of testing to throw things around as satisfying as possible. And we're really happy that now you can just sit back and mess around with all the weird things in our game with a controller - it just feels nice. And of course you can always re-map everything in the settings menu!

You can now play Space Sprouts on the go with your Steam Deck. It took us quite a bit of time (and help from our most favourite tech wizard) to optimize it for the Deck. We're really happy with its performance now and seeing our game running on that pretty OLED screen really made us smile. If you've got a Steam Deck give it a spin.

With the help of two lovely people from the Space Sprouts community the game now has an official Simplified Chinese translation. As a tiny team we are so grateful to see people actively helping us to make Space Sprouts accessible to more players around the world. Thanks so much TE-Eh & Butterfly, you're rad!
We also added three new memories to discover on your big ol' space ship. Might they be connected to this update? Take another flight, poke around and find it out yourself!

notes.title: ⭐ THE COUNTDOWN IS ON! ⭐
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/90e5c839a094c7a45af1f68f7d144646f8066db2.png[/img]

[h3][b]🚀 THE FINAL STRETCH – IT’S ALL IN THE DETAILS![/b][/h3]

[b]Dear Sproutlings[/b] 🌱,

We’re in the [b]final stretch [/b]of making [i]Space Sprouts[/i], and right now, it’s all about the [b]little details[/b]! From the [b]most remote areas[/b] to[b] dark hidden nooks[/b], we’ve been adding the finishing touches to make the game feel truly complete.

And, of course, we’ve tackled some of life’s [b]most important questions[/b], such as:
 💩 [i]What happens to poop in outer space? [/i](Yes, really.) You'll have to play the game to find out for yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/0558a6972981ba2c3d955e5dda85a2db316b7210.png[/img]

Alongside[b] fixing countless bugs [/b](while still leaving a few fun ways to break the game 🤭), we’ve added something we think you’ll love:

[h3][b]📒 A Notebook for Your Adventures![/b][/h3]

Thanks to your feedback, you will get an [b]in-game notebook[/b] with which you'll be able to:
[list]

[*] Take notes on[b] important details [/b]📝
[*] Track key discoveries [b]across multiple runs[/b] 🔍
[*] Keep a [b]personal log [/b]of your spacefaring journey 🚀
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/d3e3d384dc45b8af504856eed70af68ce50c6c31.png[/img]

You'll also be able to export your scribbles and share them with your friends! By the way, we will hold a new community challenge related to the notebook during the launch. We will announce all the details here on Steam and on [url=discord.gg/kWupKv9WGd]our Discord[/url] next week!

[h3][b]🎨 Final Touches & Even Deeper Secrets[/b][/h3]

Many sections are getting their final touch-up:
[list]

[*] [b]Objects & items[/b] have been polished and refined ✨
[*] Your [b]destination planet[/b] has been completely [b]redrawn[/b] to be more breathtaking than ever 🌍
[*] We’ve added [b]very hard memories[/b] for those of you who love to [b]dig deep and uncover every secret[/b]🧠
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/562a51504126c47dae28d1400ce76bd5d203e174.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]🌟 The Final Push[/b][/h3]
While we’re making a lot of [b]promotional efforts[/b], we’re also making sure the [b]core experience[/b] is as polished and rewarding as possible.

We’re almost there, and we can’t wait for you to experience everything we’ve been working on! As always—[b]Love, Peace & Video Games forever[/b]! 💖

⭐💚 Don’t forget to [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2790020/Space_Sprouts/]WISHLIST Space Sprouts[/url][/b]! And if you can, it would help us immensely if you could buy it and [b]leave a review as early as possible[/b], as it helps us to get more visibility from Steam! 💚⭐

We'll be back next week with all the details about the release, including details about [b]the pricing[/b], [b]the launch discount[/b] and[b] languages available [/b]at launch. Until then!

notes.title: ⭐ STEAM NEXT FEST DEMO! FINAL TOUCHES BEFORE RELEASE!⭐
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/b803455512cd32146b0bd725bc9a4c4461f5f77b.png[/img]

[h3][b]🚀 Final Touches Before Launch![/b][/h3]

Dear Sproutlings 🌱,

We’re in the final stretch of development, and Space Sprouts is getting its last big improvements before release! Every room in the ship is receiving a visual makeover and recoloring, bringing a fresh coat of paint to the entire world. But that’s not all—we’ve also added [b]new memories, edge cases, and hidden Easter eggs[/b] for players to discover. Keep your eyes open! 👀

[h3][b]🖥️ Revamped UI: Result Screens, Memories & Map[/b][/h3]
We’ve made major improvements or fully rebuilt some of the game’s UI to enhance the experience:
- [b]New animated result screens[/b] 🎉 – After each run, you’ll now see what you discovered in even cooler ways.
-[b] Improved Memory UI & popups[/b] 🧠 – Track new discoveries, recalled memories, and reconstructed ones more easily.
- [b]New Map UI [/b]🗺️ – Get a clearer overview of where you’ve been and where to go next.
- [b]Quality-of-life improvements [/b]✨ – Features like pinning memories allow for better run planning and tracking.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/f3294ce1445754529801f2ce289fa64fa1aa80b9.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]🎨 Improved Room Colors[/b][/h3]
We updated all room colors to give each room its own distinct identity. Both for better orientation and because it just looks nicer. We had this on our to-do-list since forever and now we finally had the time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/776edc6c4c99d454b4e46c0eb987af5ce1c7b026.png[/img]

[h3][b]✨ All New Key Art[/b][/h3]
The more defined Space Sprouts got over time the more we needed new key art that represents the game better. While the old key art is dear to our hearts (it accompanied us on many conventions last year) we are so happy to reveal this all new detailed illustration of Oda being maybe a bit too curious. We hope you like it as much as we do!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/158ad0399ca29c5705d0fbd744eff620ce0a90b7.png[/img]

[h3][b]🎮 Steam Next Fest – Big Demo Update![/b][/h3]
To celebrate these updates, we’ve wrapped the current state of the game into a big demo update for Steam Next Fest! This version showcases some of the new content, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2790020/Space_Sprouts/]so don’t miss it[/url]!

[h3][b]💥Most chaotic screenshot contest![/b][/h3]
To celebrate our participation at Steam Next Fest with a new demo, we're running a contest on our [url=discord.gg/kWupKv9WGd]Discord[/url]! Send us your most chaotic screenshot of the new Space Sprouts demo during the duration of the festival for a chance to win [b]a pack of stickers, a hand-drawn illustration[/b] and [b]a copy of the game[/b]!

[h3][b]🌍 Localization – Want to Help?[/b][/h3]
Last but not least, we’re currently translating the game into multiple languages! If you’re a native speaker in a language other than English and want to contribute, let us know—we’d love your support! Leave a comment below or join us on [url=discord.gg/kWupKv9WGd]Discord[/url]!

[h3][b]Love, Peace & Video Games forever! 💖[/b][/h3]
⭐ Space Sprouts is launching on March 31st! Don’t forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2790020/Space_Sprouts/]wishlist[/url] Space Sprouts on Steam to get notified at launch!! ⭐

notes.title: ⭐ RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT! MARCH 31st! ⭐
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/d7eaf70d6fba6aab9a887780f7a5f3ed22a76c00.png[/img]

[b][h1]💫BREAKING NEWS! March 31st!
The official release date for Space Sprouts! 🥳🚀[/h1][/b] 

Dear Sproutlings 🌱,

we are very excited to finally announce the release date of Space Sprouts in exactly 2 months from today, on the last day of March!

After more than 2 years of hard work we cannot wait to bring our first game out into the world!

Next month we will participate in the Steam Next Fest, which runs from Feb. 27th until March 3rd, with a brand new demo including many new areas we have added in the last month!

[h3][b]🛠️ Connecting, Polishing, and Adding Secrets[/b][/h3]

This month we've been hard at work:
[list]
[*] [b]Connecting areas[/b] and [b]filling gaps[/b] for smoother exploration 🌌
[*] Adding [b]secret tunnels [/b]for you to discover – who doesn’t love a hidden path? 🔍
[*] Replacing blockouts with [b]final artwork[/b], making each area come alive. 🎨[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/8d8e23a70fc3672fa748e54c66b7d96db8400ef7.png[/img]

[h3][b]💎 Powering Up with Gem-Powered Engines![/b][/h3]

One of the most exciting additions is the [b]new engine[/b], powered by mysterious gems. Check out the progression from sketch to final design in the images attached! This engine will be the heart of your journey, pushing you further into the cosmos.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/b6a3bb9bb3e7701cc85b106b2b879cd57fbf631c.png[/img]

[h3][b]⏳ Late Game & Playtesting[/b][/h3]

As we build out the [b]late-game areas[/b], we’ve dedicated extra time to [b]playtesting the progression[/b]. Huge thanks to our [b]dedicated playtesters[/b] for helping us refine the experience and make the late-game as thrilling as the first launch! Your support means the world to us. 💚

✨ [b]Here’s a look at how all the areas come together:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/832ef137ed6a8ec91a54bb6cc376ac7c255cb5d2.png[/img]

[h3][b]🛸 Join our playtesting sessions![/b][/h3]

If you are too impatient to wait until the release of Space Sprouts on March 31st, you can also become a playtester of the almost final version of the game, as we are still running playtesting sessions! You can sign up [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdxvUWTq7_W3PBS6I5So1SOaETvfCSSB05ROIkoYdXeUS6GUA/viewform]here[/url]!

[url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdxvUWTq7_W3PBS6I5So1SOaETvfCSSB05ROIkoYdXeUS6GUA/viewform][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/c5bf318fbbc5faea4ef7bccda8a50fa55d7be0c9.png[/img][/url]

Otherwise you can [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2790020/Space_Sprouts/]check out the current demo[/url] and join our [url=discord.gg/kWupKv9WGd]Discord[/url], there you can also let us know your feedback and hang out with us!

[url=discord.gg/kWupKv9WGd][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/183067505ac7abe80e2fdf134ae98aaf852380f5.jpg[/img][/url]

By the way, this week we reached 1,000 followers on [url=https://bsky.app/profile/schleudergames.bsky.social]🦋BlueSky[/url]! We're so happy to see this community grow 🩵 

[url=https://bsky.app/profile/schleudergames.bsky.social][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/50fa88cb6029615d299aa4bdd654b937b7efa973.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: NEW DEMO & NEW TRAILER! RELEASE WINDOW ANNOUNCEMENT!
notes.content:
Dear Sproutlings 🌱,
We are very happy to present our brand new trailer to you!

[previewyoutube=wOofT_90OLM;full][/previewyoutube]

A lot of work has gone into crafting the video to really capture what Space Sprouts is all about. Make sure to watch it here on Steam or on our socials and share it with a friend!

[b]Space Sprouts is coming to PC in early 2025, so don't forget to put it on your wishlist![/b]

[h4]New Demo![/h4] 
Along with today's trailer we also released a new demo version for you to play! We already covered some exciting information about all the changes in last week's newsletter, so here is a run down:

💼 Overhauled tutorial area with new items!
📐 New rooms and room layouts!
✨ Delicious new colors, effects and visuals!
🔥  And the chance to start a fire!

Let's take a closer look:

[h4]New Space Simulator Room![/h4]
We added a brand new room to get a feeling for your first space walk.

👨‍🚀 Become a real astronaut with your very own space suit!
🌠 Learn to evade asteroids in a zero-G-chamber!
💡 Lots of secrets and hidden mysteries waiting to be discovered!

[h4]Updated Room Layouts![/h4]
We overhauled the layouts of several rooms for smoother progress and better connections. So even if you played the old demo there are many new things to discover!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/43a72375b97d9fced4ec53b48e2dbd488d37d689.jpg[/img]

[h4]GWB Game Awards[/h4]

You can find the Steam Event here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/GWBGameAwards2024]GWB Game Awards Steam Event[/url]

[h4]Indie Arena Booth[/h4]
Back in August we got to be part of the amazing Indie Arena Booth at Gamescom where we showcased Space Sprouts! Today starts a Recap Steam Event with all the wonderful participants of IAB, so make sure to also check that out: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/IABRecap]IAB 2024 Recap Steam Event[/url]

Thank you for your support so far! Let us know what you think about the trailer and demo and leave some feedback here on Steam or on our socials!

notes.title: HUGE ANNOUNCEMENT IN 1 WEEK ⭐
notes.content:
[h2]Huge announcement in 1 week![/h2]
Dear Sproutlings 🌱,
this month has us on the edge of our seats! We are finalists for the GWB Game Awards, yay! The award ceremony will take place next week on Friday, the 22nd of November and we are one of the amazing finalists in the overseas category! We have an exciting announcement to make during the event, so keep an eye on our socials and Steam newsletter!

[h2]What have we been working on?[/h2]
The last months we've continued to work on expanding the spaceship and adding new rooms. Something else we have achieved is the complete overhaul of the tutorial, so let's look at some of the changes we made:

[h4]New tutorial area[/h4] 
We have done a complete overhaul of the tutorial and added a new area for you to explore before taking off into space. Some cool details:
[list]
[*] You will be able to crack open a cold one, rummage through suitcases with peculiar items or get a massage of interstellar quality. 💼
[*] You can also take some time to say Goodbye to Oda's family now! ❤️
[*] Handpainted murals on the walls tell the story of what every young person goes through when they reach adulthood. 🎨
[*] A huge panorama in the background gives you one last, breathtaking view of the home planet before you blast off. 🌅
[/list]
[h4]We've also added some...[/h4]
... outfit and hairstyle changes, different spaceship layout, added fire, new color design and loads of opportunities to experiment!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/78b4613be628ab566dda9ec722ce403838497a74.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/39821f73c41d727c68a3c7ef56ce5c1d11f7842f.png[/img]
[h4]In the meantime...[/h4]
... we are having fun meeting old and new friends at the GamesGround event in Berlin. Feels good to show Space Sprouts to the world and talk to players after this long stretch of continously working on new content!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/d33cd93fd086556ba38a24ffab83678a5c83782f.png[/img]

So stay tuned for next week! Peace, Love & Video Games forever! <3

⭐[b]3 NEW AREAS![/b]
💪 Space Gym: Get in shape to reveal hidden secrets and shortcuts!
🚀 Gangway: The big door has gotten a small content update, so now you can experiment with some escape pods!
🚽Toilet Room: No matter if your bowel needs some relief from all this gravity-shifting  or you're in need of some water for your shenanigans, the toilet room is the right place for you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/e614de57c92d60f96eb9cedab80c00706cc66c5b.jpg[/img]

⭐[b]REWORKED OLD STUFF![/b]
Old spaces got an architectural makeover and existing spaces have been altered and adjusted based on player feedback. There's now new things to unlock (including Steam achievements) and additional riddling involved, to get your brains going! Also: Some items might have gotten some new features, so keep an open eye! Some of them could possibly fit somewhere they didn't belong previously... 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/51f726bd1e168fb0aaacd58c06e991ba9e44c262.jpg[/img]

⭐[b]NEW ITEMS, MACHINES and a MAP![/b]
New items: A space rocket, a space thruster, plants that do weird things? We've got you covered!
New machines: An item cannon and escape pods to keep you entertained!
New map: In addition to the regular map in the launch room, you can now enter a larger map and a timeline by scrolling down on your mouse wheel!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/b8b4acc833914469947bb56850f0480306c79a7e.jpg[/img]

⭐[b]NEW VISUALS![/b]
New look for the main menu, memory menu, codepad, ... and for the gravity generators!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926451/4a6c683c9eb36818335b8f997fb3bb0804f0c197.png[/img]

While we were focusing on adding more exciting gadgets, mechanics and rooms to our new demo, we are also simultaneously finishing up the spaceship with lots of content, secrets and mechanics you will be able to play in the full version!

notes.title: 🌱DEMO AVAILABLE!🌱
notes.content:
Hey there, dear Sprout Friends! 🚀🌱Our [b]first official demo[/b] is out now!

Space Sprouts will take you into a curious space ship with whacky items and unique physics. [i]If you feel like you don't know what you're doing[/i]... Then you're doing everything right! With each loop you will figure out more and more creative ways to navigate your time in space. Have fun with it!
[list]
[*] Be sure to [b]share[/b] any [b]feedback[/b], thoughts or funny moments with us [b]in the comments or on our Discord[/b].
[*] Note that this demo is [b]currently only available in English[/b], but we are planning to localize our game upon the final release.
[*] If you encounter any problems, bugs or have questions for us, feel free to visit our community Discord or our social media channels to tell us about them.
[/list]
Peace & Love & Videogames <3
